verdict.rationale: Northwest Registered Agent holds customer business and personal data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI training is a fair privacy question for this product. The evidence pack holds no first-party material: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt. The only community item concerns SEO, not data use or AI training. With no evidence of an AI-training opt-out or policy, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
